name: v16.3.0
body:
## v16.3.0 (2022-01-26)

#### New Feature 🚀
* [#3454](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3454) feat: allow providing an object to the GraphQLError constructor ([@n1ru4l](https://github.com/n1ru4l))
* [#3464](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3464) Expose `getArgumentValues` as public API ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))

#### Bug Fix 🐞
* [#3442](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3442)  Prevent Infinite Loop in OverlappingFieldsCanBeMergedRule ([@nicolaslt](https://github.com/nicolaslt))
* [#3455](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3455) OverlappingFieldsCanBeMerged: sort argument values before comparing ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))

#### Docs 📝
<details>
<summary> 2 PRs were merged </summary>

* [#3269](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3269) feat: setup docs site ([@saihaj](https://github.com/saihaj))
* [#3437](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3437) CONTRIBUTING.md: remove reference to Facebook bug bounty program ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
</details>

#### Polish 💅
<details>
<summary> 7 PRs were merged </summary>

* [#3441](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3441) UniqueArgumentDefinitionNamesRule: Improve tests ([@Cito](https://github.com/Cito))
* [#3446](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3446) Use 'eslint-plugin-simple-import-sort' to sort imports ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3447](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3447) Fix index.ts files to be compatible with Typedoc ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3452](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3452) validation-test.ts: various grammar fixes ([@spawnia](https://github.com/spawnia))
* [#3457](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3457) OverlappingFieldsCanBeMergedRule: simplify argument comparison ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3459](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3459) blockString-tests: remove duplicate test, fix grammar ([@Cito](https://github.com/Cito))
* [#3461](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3461) visit: simplify handling of root node ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
</details>

#### Internal 🏠
<details>
<summary> 5 PRs were merged </summary>

* [#3433](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3433) gh/actions: refactor out action to deploy branches ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3434](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3434) gh/actions: remove 'npm dedupe' check since it unexpectadly do update ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3435](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3435) gh/actions: run benchmark & diff-npm-package only on PRs ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3436](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3436) gh/actions: make all cloned repo read-only ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3443](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3443) ci/checkPackageLock: update only package-lock.json ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
</details>

#### Dependency 📦
<details>
<summary> 4 PRs were merged </summary>

* [#3438](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3438) Update deps ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3444](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3444) Update deps ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3462](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3462) Update deps ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
* [#3463](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-js/pull/3463) Update deps + fix 'npm audit' ([@IvanGoncharov](https://github.com/IvanGoncharov))
</details>
